'''Vanto Bazren''', also known as '''Fuse''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Republic soldier]] who was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in [[Havoc Squad]] until he defected to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Realizing that he made a mistake of serving the Empire, he was later turned back to the Republic side by [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Havoc Squad's new commander]].

==Biography==
Vanto had advanced degrees in chemical engineering, structural engineering, and music theory. He was the youngest member of [[Havoc Squad]].

In [[3643 BBY]], Vanto was stationed on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during a [[Separatist War|civil war]], where he located a nuclear [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb|ZR-57 bomb]] that the Separatists developed. He gave instructions to a newly recruited soldier to defuse a couple of mines and prevent the bomb from being used. Eventually, he along with several members of Havoc Squad betrayed the Republic since they were betrayed on Ando Prime.

Sometime after betraying the Republic, Fuse went to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he intended to study bombs and use them to deactivate walkers by an electric charge inside the bomb, but [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gorik]] wanted to use these bombs on a live testing ground rather than an open desert. Vanto refused and was locked in a cell. While his bombs were used to terrorize civilians, he quickly contacted the new [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] where he didn't forget since his time on Ord Mantell. He gave the lieutenant and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Aric Jorgan|Jorgan]] the coordinates of a secret base in a [[Hidden cave (Jundland Wastes)|cave]] where the bombs had been kept. After the members of Havoc Squad defused and destroyed the bombs, they located the last bomb near a prison where Vanto was being held. As they arrived, Fuse refused to be saved, saying that he wasn't worth the risk, and told his rescuers to stop Gorik. The lieutenant refused to leave him and chose to get him out when the bomb self-destructed. Vanto thanked the lieutenant for everything and agreed to return to the Republic for everything he had done. His position in Havoc Squad was later filled by [[Tanno Vik]].
